name: spreadsheetSetRepeatingRows
description: Sets rows that repeat on every printed page.

params.name: rows
params.description: Range of rows to repeat, such as 1:1.

rustcfml.notes: Not supported on wasm32. Implemented with the _xlnm.Print_Titles defined name. Member form: setRepeatingRows(rows).

examples.title: Repeat a header row when printing
examples.description: Row 1 repeats at the top of every printed page.
